what_this_is: ADJUDICATION, not inter-annotator agreement. A second reader was shown annotator 1's completed labels and asked to review them, rather than labelling the 200 rows independently. That produces a better gold set and CANNOT produce Cohen's kappa: a reviewer who starts from another person's answers agrees with them by construction. No agreement statistic may be computed from this.

changes.piece: Too much noise pollution from road and bars ...
changes.reason: Cleanliness is defined as litter, plastic, rubbish, smells and upkeep. Noise is listed under crowd -- 'busy, queues, noise'. The guidelines put this in a different aspect.

changes.piece: A real danger to all forms of marine life.
changes.reason: Safety is defined as risk TO A VISITOR -- slippery ground, deep water, warnings to other visitors. Danger to marine life is environmental, not visitor safety. The pipeline made the same mistake and annotator 1 agreed with it.

still_outstanding: An independent second pass over the same 200 rows, labelled blind, is the only thing that yields a reliability figure. reports/LABEL_THESE_annotator2.xlsx is empty and ready.
